gitCommit.subject: ci: add benchmark workflow
gitCommit.body:
ci: add benchmark workflow

Runs the benchmark on GitHub's servers: starts the backend, builds the
chosen level with a real model, deploys to Vercel, runs the specs, and
commits score.json, builds.json, results.json and the backend log to
the benchmark-results branch. Triggered by a push to run-benchmark or
from the Actions tab.
